newsitem.title: USA: Standard Motor to divest division.
newsitem.headline: Standard Motor to divest division.

text.p: Standard Motor Products Inc., a major manufacturer of auto replacement parts, said Thursday it plans to divest its Service Line Division because the business was no longer compatible with its long-term strategy.
Standard said it has been in contact with a number of potential buyers for the division, which makes general service parts, accessories, speciality tools and other products for used cars.
"At this stage, the timing, pricing and terms of any possible transaction cannot be predicted," Standard said.
The division had revenues of $43 million in 1996.
Standard, based in New York, makes engine management systems, climate control systems and brake systems.
Its stock was unchanged at $13.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
